test_keywords_conflict_message: test that protobuf messages named with Python keywords like class can be instantiated and used
test_keywords_conflict_nested_message: test that nested messages named with Python keywords like try can be accessed and set
test_keywords_conflict_field: test that message fields named with Python keywords like if and as can be set via setattr
test_keywords_conflict_enum: test that enum values named with Python keywords like else and True can be assigned to fields
test_keywords_conflict_extension: test that protobuf extensions named with Python keywords like continue and return can be used
